# 2 bed terraced house for sale

> Galvin Property are delighted to bring No. 22 Park Drive Grove to the open market for sale. This spacious two-bedroom mid-terrace property enjoys a great location, with off-street parking and a sizeable rear garden. The front door opens into a spacious living room, with stairs to the first-floor landing and understairs storage.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 2 bed
- Plocha: 60 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C2
- Lokalita: Dublin 15
- Cena: 375 000 €
